description: Save to the user's Notion as a NEW page: a research report, competitor teardown or campaign report as `content` (markdown: headings, lists, links, and an image or video URL on its own line becomes the media), a swipefile collection (swipefileCollection: name or id; each ad with its creative, copy, run dates and link), the content calendar (includeSchedule:true), or a mix. Put it under parentPageId, as a row in databaseId, or omit both for a private page in their workspace. Long text is split across blocks, never cut. The answer is read back from Notion. Free; never overwrites anything.

dataSourceId.description: data source id to save into as a new row; pass only one of parentPageId, databaseId, dataSourceId

databaseId.description: database id or link: saves as a new row

parentPageId.description: page id or link to save under

title.description: title of the new Notion page

name: save_to_notion
title: Save to Notion
